response.original_title: LITTLE GREEN MEN: QUIP'S IN CHARGE
response.overview: Quip, the assistant to the evil space empress Eclipse, is eager to prove his worth; He finally gets his chance when he’s left in charge of the ship for the day - but he soon finds out he bites off more than he can chew. Can Quip and his trusty friend Proko be able to right their wrongs save the day? (Probably not...)
